title: saxifraga stellaris subsp. clusii
intro: Saxifraga stellaris subsp. clusii, commonly known as Clusius's saxifrage, is a sub-species of the Saxifraga stellaris plant, which belongs to the Saxifragaceae family. This perennial plant is native to the Pyrenees, and its leaves and roots are used in traditional medicine due to their reported health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Saxifraga stellaris subsp. clusii are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antimicrobial effects, and provide relief from digestive issues. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to fully understand its effects.
